blocks.text: Anasir ko mote taur par dhaaton (metals), ghair-dhaaton (non-metals) aur metalloids mein baanta ja sakta hai. Metals electrons kho kar musbat ions banane ka rujhan rakhte hain; loha, tanba, sona aur chandi misalein hain. Non-metals electrons le kar manfi ions banane ka rujhan rakhte hain; chlorine, sulfur aur phosphorus misalein hain. Metalloids periodic table par metals aur non-metals ko alag karte hain aur dono ki kuch khusoosiyat dikhate hain.

Zyada tar periodic tables par ek seerhi-numa (stair-step) lakeer hoti hai jo in girohon ki pehchan karati hai. Lakeer boron (B) se shuru ho kar polonium (Po) tak neeche jati hai, Si, Ge, As, Sb aur Te ko shamil karte hue. Lakeer ke baen ke anasir metals hain; us ke theek daen ke anasir metals aur non-metals dono ki khusoosiyat dikhate hain aur metalloids ya semimetals kehlate hain; bilkul daen ke anasir non-metals hain. Istisna hydrogen hai, table ka pehla unsur.

blocks.alt: Jadeed periodic table: 118 anasir (elements), 7 periods aur 18 groups mein. Har khaane mein atomic number, symbol, naam aur average atomic mass hai (namoona: Pt, platinum, 78, 195.1). Rang batate hain: alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, transition metals, other metals, metalloids, non-metals, halogens aur noble gases; lanthanides (57-71) aur actinides (89-103) neeche do qataaron mein hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.1: Jadeed periodic table (kitab ki Figure 1.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Groups 1 se 18 baayen se daayen aur periods 1 se 7 upar se neeche hain. Group 1 mein hydrogen aur alkali metals, group 2 mein alkaline earth metals, groups 3 se 12 mein transition metals, aur groups 13 se 18 mein other metals, metalloids, non-metals, halogens (group 17) aur noble gases (group 18) hain. Group 3 ke 57-71 aur 89-103 wale khaane lanthanides aur actinides ke liye hain jo table ke neeche alag do qataaron mein chhape hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar Pt (platinum) wala namoona dekhein: khaane ke upar atomic number (78), beech mein bara symbol (Pt), neeche naam aur average atomic mass (195.1). Har unsur ka khaana isi tarteeb se hai. Rang se pehchanein ke unsur kis qism ka hai: peela alkali metal, naranji alkaline earth metal, neela transition metal, gehra neela other metal, grey metalloid, gulabi non-metal, halka neela halogen aur jamni noble gas. Seerhi-numa lakeer (stair-step line) jis ka zikr upar hai, boron (B) se polonium (Po) tak grey metalloids ke kinare chalti hai. Helium ki configuration 1s2 hai, phir bhi woh noble gases ke saath group 18 mein rakha jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Hydrogen table ke oopar baen bethta hai, jahan metals hain. Use istisna kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Stair-step lakeer ke baen ki har cheez metal gini jati hai, magar hydrogen, pehla unsur, ek non-metal hai jo neeche ke alkali metals ki tarah electrons khone ke bajaye lete ya baantta hai, is liye yeh qaide ka istisna hai.

items: Metals electrons khote hain (musbat ions); non-metals lete hain (manfi ions); metalloids dono ki khusoosiyat rakhte hain.
Boron se polonium tak stair-step lakeer (Si, Ge, As, Sb, Te) baen ke metals ko daen ke non-metals se alag karti hai, metalloids us ke saath; hydrogen istisna hai.
